title: DeskStride Extension Registry Entry
description: One entry describing a single published .dsext extension. The package file itself is never stored in this repo. downloadUrl may point at ANY public host: an author's own repo/release, or a shared packaged-packages repo holding only built packages (see the README section Two ways to host a package).

id.description: Must match the id in the extension's own manifest.json. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter or digit; max 64 chars.

authorProfile.description: Host-neutral profile/homepage URL for the author (any git host, not assumed to be GitHub).

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the .dsext file matching latestVersion.

sigUrl.description: Direct download URL for the detached .sig file matching downloadUrl, if the extension is signed. The app downloads this to a <tempfile>.sig sidecar before verification.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .dsext file at downloadUrl, lowercase hex.

permissions.description: Mirror of the permissions declared in the extension's manifest.json. Written by publish tooling; omitted when the manifest declares none.

platforms.description: OSes the extension works on, mirrored from the manifest. Omitted means not declared (not all). The app hides the entry on any other OS.

attended.description: true if a person must be present while it runs. Omitted means not declared.

requiresInternet.description: true if a node needs the network at run time. Omitted means not declared.

nodeTypes.description: Node types the extension registers, read from its code by the publish tooling.

tags.description: Search words, mirrored from the manifest.

pipDependencies.description: Extra components installed with the extension, as written in the manifest. Omitted when none.

npmDependencies.description: Extra components installed with the extension (needs Node.js installed). Omitted when none.

verified.description: true only once both signed and reviewed by a registry maintainer.

revoked.description: true if this extension (or this version) has been de-listed for a safety reason. The app never auto-uninstalls on this -- it surfaces a warning badge with revokedReason and a one-click uninstall shortcut.
